improvements: Exact source building outlines, inner rings and uncovered building-part strips now survive the tourist renderer; no scenery mask removes a building.
Rachel now receives a visible player-triggered coin arc and awards completion after the drop; idle time and cancellation do not award it.
remainingGaps: The full-size postcard shows PUBLIC MARKET CENTER lettering and clock. Arcade soffits, market roof edges and surrounding frontage proportions still need matched independent street and aerial comparisons.
Nearby crowds can obscure the market approach; the tilted-sign audit finding still needs physical inspection.
Fish and gum-wall handlers have not received the same complete participation and cancellation review as Rachel.
Raw audit findings remain for physical review: zfight 35, signTilted 1.
historicalCollections.review: Inspected arrival, native public-path walk, postcard and activity approach at clean 94ef228; also inspected the full-size postcard. Existing Starbucks frontage is retained; the secret room remains the owner's explicit fiction exception.
